title: Trade Into Mate
setup: Both sides have rooks on the c-file, and Black's rook on c8 is defended by its queen alone.
hint: Count attackers and defenders on the back-rank square, and remember the king cannot help.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc8+}} forces {{Qxc8}} — the king has no square and the queen cannot block from b7 — and the second rook finishes with {{Rxc8#}}. One defender cannot hold a square that two rooks attack.
